ex.en: This is the finest view I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最美麗的景色。

ex.en: This tower commands a full view of the city.
ex.zh: 從這座塔上可以看到整個城市的景色。

ex.en: Concerning this problem, our views are not the same.
ex.zh: 在這個問題上，我們的看法不一樣。

ex.en: Sometimes he has difficulty being articulate about his views.
ex.zh: 他有時很難把自己的看法說清楚。

ex.en: I viewed my action as a crime.
ex.zh: 我把自己的行為看成是犯罪。

ex.en: Many people view the plan as too risky.
ex.zh: 很多人認為這個計畫風險太高。

ex.en: If your visa expires, you must leave China.
ex.zh: 如果簽證過期，你就必須離開中國。

ex.en: I visited the house in which Shakespeare was born.
ex.zh: 我去參觀了莎士比亞出生的房子。

ex.en: We visited his home country for the first time.
ex.zh: 我們第一次去了他的家鄉。

ex.en: Tom visits Mary every time he goes to Boston.
ex.zh: 湯姆每次去波士頓都去看瑪麗。

ex.en: He comes to visit us every now and then.
This is my first visit to Taiwan.
We paid a visit to our grandparents last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末去探望了祖父母。

visual aid.zh: 視覺輔助工具（圖表、投影片等）

ex.en: Using visual aids makes your presentation easier to follow.
ex.zh: 使用視覺輔助工具能讓簡報更容易理解。

ex.en: The teacher used maps as visual aids.
ex.zh: 老師用地圖當作視覺輔助工具。
